rule_name: Collateral balance is as of the run date
LEI is 20 upper-case alphanumeric characters
Credit rating is populated
Sector is populated
ISIN has valid format and ISO 6166 check digit
ISIN is unique across instruments
Currency is populated
Asset class is a recognised value
No stale price (5 identical closes in a row)
Price exists for every instrument on every business day
Close price is present and positive
One price per instrument per date
No isolated price spike (> 40% move that reverses)
Instrument exists in the validated instrument master
Quantity is positive
Settlement date is on or after trade date
Price within 10% of trade-date close
Trade ID is unique (first delivery wins)
Counterparty exists in the validated counterparty master
Side is BUY or SELL
